question: Who is the author of 'Early History of India’?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Vincent Arthur Smith.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• V.A. Smith wrote the book** "Early History of India"** in 1904.
 
• Vincent Arthur Smith, CIE, was an **Irish Indologist and art historian**.
 
• He was **one of the important figures** who took a colonial approach to **Indian historiography.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcTwzujY3RcyiKIWKNKIZ_SvgeTMM2kp1h-WOQ&usqp=CAU] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sir Ramakrishna Gopal Bhandarkar** was an Indian scholar, orientalist, and social reformer.​ 
 
• **Kallidaikurichi Aiyah** Nilakanta Sastri was **an** Indian historian who wrote on South Indian history.
 
• **Ramesh Chandra Majumdar** was a historian and professor of Indian history.
